notes.title: Shadow Seven Welcomes New Programmer & Demo Overhaul Incoming!
notes.content:
We are excited to announce that Shadow Seven has welcomed a new programmer to the team, and we are eager to dive into development!

Given the technical issues with our demo, we have decided to temporarily remove it from the Steam page. Rest assured, the demo will return in a much-improved state, free of errors.

Stay tuned for more updates!

notes.title: Shadow Seven on Czech & Slovak Games Week 2023!
notes.content:
[b]Hello everyone! [/b]

Shadow Seven is part of CZ/SK Games Week. We decided to start uncovering details about the characters and the story. 

Soon we will introduce you to the veterans of the War of the Dozen Brothers, which divided the dwarf empire into small kingdoms competing with each other. We'll reveal details about gear and their environmental adventages, and of course, special abilities.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43101382/d815cee85120f7191108c25ed540dd1cda1f333a.png[/img]

The available demo has undergone several improvements and we hope that you will play it much better.


Don't forget to follow us and add Shadow Seven to your wishlist. 


Regards R.R.Team

notes.title: Shadow Seven are part of the Steam Stealth Fest Event
notes.content:
Hello everyone! 

We modified the demo to make it a bit easier and added hints boards for abilities and environment usage.

We hope you will like the game and of course any feedback is welcome!

notes.title: A new Title for our game is Shadow Seven
notes.content:
After a year, we got a little used to the working title, but we had to do it ːsteamsadː

The demo is being fixed to make your Sparkler quest a little more enjoyable.

 Follow us and don't forget to add Shadow Seven to your wishlist.

notes.title: Hotfix January 2nd
notes.content: In this small update, we have fixed a bug, where the achievement "A Road Above the Ground" couldn't be unlocked.

notes.title: Pre-Alpha Demo Update December 20th
notes.content:
Hello, dwarfs! We have brought to you an update, which should hopefully reduce the confusion levels of our players.

What has changed:
[list]
[*] Added a Diary, containing information about the Objectives and Controls, as well as some Hints (this is still Work In Progress, please ignore the visuals of it!)
[*] Added a Map, marking the objectives across the whole level.
[*] Fixed a bug, where Dark Walker couldn't run after viewing a cutscene.
[*] Added a new cutscene near the beginning.
[*] Prolonged the introductory cutscene to show the first objective.
[/list]

We hope you like the changes so far! We are eager to listen to your feedback, so we can do more of them! Don't hesitate to tell us on our [url=https://discord.gg/E8wYbsaPdw]Discord[/url]!

notes.title: The Parvificent Seven Pre-Alpha Demo Is Out!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43101382/168acb7d88aa7ed6db729e26e7f577c02f8eed91.png[/img]

After working hard like dwarfs in a mine, we have finally decided to share our work with you!

With that said, we would like to share our future plans in the following list:

[h1]Roadmap 2023[/h1]
[list]
[*] Improve the visuals of Vision Cone
[*] Improve physics of dead enemies
[*] Add the remaining 4 dwarfs!
[*] Add at least 3 new missions!
[*] Improve the enemy AI
[*] Add more enemies!
[/list]
Excited? Good! We would love to hear from you in our [url=https://discord.gg/E8wYbsaPdw]Discord[/url]! Any form of feedback is very much appreciated.

Have fun!
